title: Are you following your dreams?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How do you tell the difference between a real personal dream and a goal you feel pressured to want?
Should people pursue a dream even when the chance of success is very small?
When is giving up on a dream a wise decision rather than a failure?
How can someone pursue an ambitious goal without damaging their finances or relationships?
What dream would you regret never attempting?
